dims.name: Acts
dims.question: What does the agent do on its own?

next_unlock.needs: Public evidence that the agent works independently; the person approves critical decisions only.
Public evidence that agents operate across organisational boundaries or disparate stacks; and that others build on it: third parties publish integrations, skills or agents for it.
Public evidence that high-impact actions need a person's approval; and that what it can reach is enumerated: scopes, permissions, tools.
Public evidence that test or evaluation results are published.

gamma_ray.fact_ray: 18 facts: 18 π Moderate. Each is written beside its evidence above.

configs.what: Voice AI Agent with its documented defaults.
Deployment practice stated for healthcare customers: scope and data agreed with the customer's DPO before go-live.
The deployment service described under 'How we deploy' on the product pages: a Visor team, end-to-end testing, validation by the customer's team before launch, and training of the customer's people.

facts.label: It executes actions itself
facts.fact: At Generali, the platform was connected to the insurer's systems through web services, so four common requests (duplicate documents, address changes, adding a vehicle, cancellations) run end to end as automated workflows.
facts.quote: those requests now run end to end as automated workflows

facts.label: The agent handles routine tasks; the person is consulted on exceptions
facts.fact: At Generali the chat agent handles conversations from start to finish; when a conversation needs a person, an advisor picks it up in live chat.
facts.quote: When a conversation does need a person, an advisor picks it up

facts.label: It works across several domains or systems
facts.fact: The voice agent connects to telephony and to the customer's contact-centre or CCaaS platform.
facts.quote: It connects to your telephony and to your contact-centre or CCaaS platform

facts.label: It connects to external tools or services across a trust boundary
facts.fact: Generali connected the platform to its own systems through web services.
facts.quote: connected the platform to its own systems through web services

facts.label: A limit on it is a rule in prose
facts.fact: For healthcare, the page states as a rule that the agents do not give clinical advice and are set up to pass a clinical question to a person.
facts.quote: The agents don't give clinical advice

facts.label: Its limits and known failure cases are documented for those who use it
facts.fact: A reliability note states that the models can occasionally fail and that providers do not guarantee total availability.
facts.quote: The models generate each answer in the moment and can occasionally fail.

facts.label: The data it uses is described
facts.fact: The chat agent answers from a knowledge base built from the customer's documents and kept in sync with them.
facts.quote: The agent answers from a knowledge base built from your own documents

facts.label: The models and third-party components it uses are listed
facts.fact: The security page lists the AI providers in the voice and chat path (Azure, Vertex AI Gemini, Deepgram, AssemblyAI, ElevenLabs) and what each processes.
facts.quote: Gemini large language models used by the AI agents to process conversations

help.label: Our hypothesis, not their claim. Built from public pages only; nothing of theirs was tested.
help.pitch: RiskMandate would measure, for one real deployment of Visor.ai's agents, what each agent was asked to do (its mandate), what its credentials and connections actually let it reach (its grant), and the difference between the two (the gap), and keep that as a written record. It is read-only: never in the request path.

items.title: Check and claim the GAMMA-Ray card
items.text: The card is beta and read only from public pages; Visor.ai has not reviewed it. A correction is dated and published, and a file at /.well-known/fact-ray.json on their own domain raises the trust of every fact on it.

items.text: Pick one agent in one deployment; RiskMandate records its mandate, its grant and the gap, read-only. The lens page explains the measurement.

items.text: The same task run bare and under one policy, with the probes and the record public, as in our own harness runs (simulated data only).
